scope: P4 launch-contract probe against the P1-qualified binary in a disposable Lapis service home. No model turn is required for the transport decision; one live regression proves the probe does not disturb response routing.

decision.reason: Lapis launches one dedicated app-server with --listen unix://<endpoint>.codex and passes that exact endpoint to the TUI with --remote. Candidate source selection prefers an explicit remote endpoint over local daemon discovery, and the live process/state inventory found no daemon.

validation.name: no-model-launch-contract
validation.result: Passed in 2.016 seconds: managed TUI startup and attention attachment, same-child detach/reattach, abrupt service death cleanup, dedicated backend process, exact explicit-remote TUI arguments and child PID/parent, no daemon process/state in the disposable fixture, explicit daemon-state paths checked, and endpoint peer PID matching the backend.

validation.name: live-routing-regression
validation.result: All 13 live GLM service/desktop checks passed in 65.106 seconds while recording the same dedicated-launch contract.

validation.name: focused-unit-tests
validation.result: 21 tests passed, including positive and negative dedicated-endpoint, child, daemon and peer-PID process-contract regressions.

validation.name: python-lint-and-format
validation.command: ruff check --config ruff.toml scripts/check_service_attention.py scripts/tests/test_check_service_attention.py && ruff format --config ruff.toml --check scripts/check_service_attention.py scripts/tests/test_check_service_attention.py

non_claims: No installed or user-owned Codex daemon was started, stopped, inspected or modified.
This does not qualify managed-daemon lifecycle, update identity, remote-control pairing, two-thread worktrees, broader request kinds, package behavior, Linux or native input/GPU.
A future launcher that omits the explicit remote endpoint or creates daemon state must repeat this probe and make a new adoption decision.
